Homework exercise · Week 3

Pet Reactions

Scratch (offline app) Work in pairs

Goal: make a virtual pet that reacts to a click, a key press and the mouse. Time: about 10 minutes. Tool: Scratch app (offline).

Build steps

  1. Open Scratch. Keep the cat as your pet, or click Choose a Sprite and pick any animal.
  2. Build the three scripts below. Each one starts with a different event.
  3. Click the green flag. Then click the pet, press space, and move the mouse over the pet.
  4. Save as pet-reactions.

The scripts in words

Pet sprite, three scripts:

  1. when this sprite clicked
    • say "Purr!" for 1 seconds
    • start sound (any sound from the dropdown)
  2. when space key pressed
    • next costume
  3. when green flag clicked
    • forever:
      • if touching mouse-pointer? then
        • say "Pet me more!"
      • else
        • say "" (empty)

Expected behavior

Clicking the pet makes it purr and play a sound. Pressing space changes its costume. After the green flag, the pet says "Pet me more!" whenever the mouse is over it, and stops talking when the mouse moves away.

Checklist

Stuck? Open a hint

Try on your own first. Hints open one at a time, from a small nudge to a bigger one. None of them gives the answer away.

Hint 1: Where to look

You need three separate scripts. Each starts with a different yellow Events block. Look at what starts each one: a click on the pet, a key press, and the green flag.

Hint 2: Try this

Find when this sprite clicked, when ( ) key pressed and when green flag clicked in the Events category. Under each one, add the blocks that make the pet react. Look in Looks and Sound for the reactions.

Hint 3: Almost there

For the mouse script, put if ... then ... else from Control inside forever. Put touching ( mouse-pointer )? from Sensing in the if hole. Put a say ( ) in each part, and leave one empty. For the key script, use next costume from Looks.
